name: Chowder
body:
Station and Complexity entremetier 3, line cook 3, poissonier 3

Flavor Profiles salty, texture, temperature
Additional Ingredients bitter, spicy, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level or until discharged; Serving Size 1d8

DESCRIPTION

A chowder is a stew of milk or cream, flavored with fish or vegetables, and thickened with broken crackers, biscuits, or roux.

When consumed, it grants temporary immunity to electricity damage, as the protection from energy spell.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1 and add immunity to fire (spicy) or another energy of your choice (bitter or umami) for the duration. Each immunity consumes the same pool of absorption.
